decisions.reason: It builds on the established offer and remains on the website, with no signal of a shortfall relative to aspirations, so slack supports keeping it.
It has its own page and evidence of real-site use, indicating results meet or exceed aspirations, so the firm is very unlikely to drop it.
It uses proven components and is still mentioned, suggesting satisfactory performance and no need for problemistic search.
It is presented on its own page and builds on existing capabilities, implying it is seen as a valuable part of the portfolio.
Although it is newer and only mentioned, it is close to the established offer and the firm has slack to allow time for uncertain results to develop.
